scope: Prepare revision/check changes, verification setup and completion identity/file checks outside SQLite write transactions, with revision and request replay checks at publication.
Materialize each adapter command once per Check/subject and reuse it for runtime identity, execution and receipt comparison.
Load explicit plugin roots in private packages without modifying process-wide sys.path.

verification.sandbox_unit_skip_reason: Windows-specific checks on a Linux host

source.manifest_rule: SHA-256 each src/**/*.py and tests/**/*.py plus extra_paths, indexed by relative path; SHA-256 the sorted-key compact JSON mapping.

compatibility: Conflicting updates return RUN_CONFLICT or VERIFICATION_CONFLICT; no automatic mutation retry is introduced.
Plugins using import_root must use package-relative imports for local helpers; absolute imports use installed application dependencies.
Pinned implementation changes require a new Run. Historical records are not rewritten.
limitations: Controlled contention and actual local Sandbox checks, not a production load or commercial-model benchmark.
Plugins remain trusted application code. Reports remain unsigned local-advisory records.
